inspected_anchors.finding: Symbolic node assertions include existence, ordering and input constraints; these are workflow specifications, not a bank identification theorem.
307 AgentFail logs plus 136 n8n cases; dynamic verification uses original test inputs and bounded repair retries.
Table II: repair 71.3%, failure attribution84.4%; RCA87.9% is conditional on correct attribution; three repeated repairs per case; differences are percentage points.
Pre-execution filtering precision99.7% and recall84.6%; some model/tool failures only emerge during dynamic execution.

Fifteen-model comparison: high verdict accuracy can coexist with low uncertainty detection; paper-reported GPT-5 scores90.2% verdict accuracy and12.8% uncertainty-detection F1.
3455 complete,1362 missing and257 uncertain cases; conditioned verdict accuracy varies strongly by case type.
Synthetic narratives, idealized Ask interface and MN29-specific rules limit transfer to live or other-domain environments.
